Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, tempfile, subprocess, os, sys
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
name='corpus/insn-good.s.cs_e3f000000004'
base=bytearray(z.read(name))
for extra in [b'\x00', b'\xff', b'\x00\x00', b'\xff\xff', b'\x90'*16, b'\x00'*16, b'\xff'*16]:
    d=base+extra
    fd, path=tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', suffix='.bin')
    os.write(fd, d); os.close(fd)
    res=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm', path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    print(len(d), res.returncode)
    if res.returncode!=0:
        print(res.stderr.decode('latin1','ignore')[:500])
        break
PY` executed with exit code 0.
